title: Marketplace Trip Fee, Booking Deposit and Driver Age Figures Across the Keyturn Trip Booking Rate Plans
content:
The marketplace trip fee charged to the guest, the refundable deposit authorised at booking and the driver ages a plan will book at are all plan figures on a Keyturn Trip Booking. They are set out here for all six rate plans.

| Rate plan | Trip fee (per cent of base rate) | Trip fee floor (USD) | Deposit authorised (USD) | Deposit hold after trip end (calendar days) | Driver score waiving the deposit | Young-driver surcharge (per cent of base rate) | Young-driver threshold (whole years) | Youngest driver bookable (whole years) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan | 12.5 | 3.95 | 0.00 | 0 | 70 | 22 | 25 | 21 |
| Keyturn Daily Rate Plan | 11.5 | 4.95 | 250.00 | 7 | 75 | 20 | 25 | 21 |
| Keyturn Weekend Rate Plan | 11.0 | 5.95 | 300.00 | 7 | 75 | 18 | 25 | 21 |
| Keyturn Weekly Rate Plan | 9.5 | 7.95 | 400.00 | 10 | 80 | 15 | 25 | 21 |
| Keyturn Monthly Rate Plan | 8.0 | 9.95 | 600.00 | 14 | 85 | 12 | 25 | 23 |
| Keyturn Extended Stay Rate Plan | 7.0 | 12.95 | 900.00 | 21 | 90 | 10 | 25 | 25 |

### Notes on the columns

The trip fee is a percentage of the base rate and carries a floor in dollars beneath it; both figures are plan figures. The deposit column is the refundable amount authorised at booking, and the hold column is the calendar days that authorisation stays in place after the trip ends: on the Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan both stand at nothing, so that plan authorises no deposit and holds one for 0 days. The driver score column is the marketplace driving score at or above which the deposit is not taken.

The young-driver threshold is 25 whole years on every one of the six plans; what moves across the ladder is the surcharge itself, which falls from 22 per cent on the Keyturn Hourly Rate Plan to 10 per cent on the Keyturn Extended Stay Rate Plan, and the youngest age the plan will book a driver at, which rises from 21 to 25 whole years.
